relations.subject: service:analytics-service
relations.evidence: Because Analytics supports efficient parallel query processing and bulk data handling, and runs on separate nodes in a Couchbase cluster, Couchbase Analytics is often preferable for expensive queries, even if the queries are predetermined and could be supported by a frontend (operational) index.

relations.subject: service:analytics-service
relations.evidence: The Analytics service enables you to create shadow copies of the data that you want to analyze.

relations.subject: service:analytics-service
relations.evidence: When the shadowed Analytics data is linked to the operational data, changes in the operational data are reflected in your Analytics data in real time.

relations.subject: service:analytics-service
relations.evidence: a fast memory-to-memory protocol that Couchbase Server nodes use to synchronize data among themselves — so Analytics runs on data that's extremely current, without ETL (extract, transform, load) or other hassles and delays.
